title: $12.4M Black Friday Flash Sales Engine Deal with Global Retail Consortium
executive_summary: A $12.4M three-year agreement to power Black Friday flash sales for 400+ enterprise retailers with peak load guarantees. Technical review reveals critical scaling, availability, and support gaps between sales promises and engineering capacity.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text:
Our Flash Sales Engine guarantees zero-downtime scaling up to 250,000 checkout requests/sec during Black Friday peak events, with 99.99% uptime SLA and sub-100ms checkout latency globally. All platform upgrades and security patches are applied with zero customer impact via live blue-green deployments, ensuring continuous sales operation.

We include unlimited SKU catalog hosting with instant global inventory sync and proven handling of over 1.5 million SKUs per tenant, plus dedicated 24/7 white-glove support with 5-minute critical incident response. Transaction fees are capped at 0.5% with guaranteed PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance and real-time fraud screening on every order at no extra cost.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text:
The architecture is validated for sustained throughput of 85,000 checkout requests/sec per region with autoscaling to 120,000 requests/sec burst for 15 minutes, requiring read-replica lag under 2 seconds. Scheduled maintenance windows are required every Sunday 02:00-04:00 UTC for database sharding rebalancing and cache invalidation, during which checkout API returns 503 for up to 12 minutes.

Catalog service supports up to 2 million SKUs per tenant with inventory sync propagation of 45-90 seconds across regions via eventual consistency. Standard support includes 99.9% platform availability excluding maintenance windows, with P1 incident response target of 60 minutes during business hours (08:00-20:00 EST) and PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance for card vault only, fraud screening available as paid add-on.

commitments.claim: Zero-downtime scaling to 250,000 checkout requests/sec with no customer impact
commitments.proposal_quote: zero-downtime scaling up to 250,000 checkout requests/sec
commitments.spec_quote: Scheduled maintenance windows are required every Sunday 02:00-04:00 UTC for database sharding rebalancing and cache invalidation, during which checkout API returns 503 for up to 12 minutes
commitments.explanation: Proposal promises zero-downtime and 250k rps, while spec mandates weekly downtime with 503 errors and validates only 85k sustained / 120k burst, directly contradicting both availability and throughput.
Technical spec contains no fee schedule, pricing cap, or billing logic, providing zero engineering or contractual basis for the 0.5% cap.

commitments.spec_quote: inventory sync propagation of 45-90 seconds across regions via eventual consistency
commitments.explanation: 'Instant' is undefined and leaves uncertainty whether 45-90 second eventual consistency meets the sales promise, creating oversell risk during flash-sale inventory races.

commitments.claim: Catalog handling of over 1.5 million SKUs per tenant
commitments.proposal_quote: proven handling of over 1.5 million SKUs per tenant
commitments.spec_quote: Catalog service supports up to 2 million SKUs per tenant
commitments.explanation: Spec capacity of 2 million SKUs per tenant fully covers and confirms the proposal claim of over 1.5 million SKUs.
